description: A plain arming sword issued to Vesper's gate watch. Balanced, unremarkable, reliable.
flavor: Every legend starts with a borrowed edge.
name: Recruit's Blade

description: An old ceremonial blade whose edge glows beneath moonlight.
flavor: Forged for an order that no longer answers its name.
name: Moonsteel Sabre

specials.description: Gains magic damage in moonlit rooms.

description: The duelling blade of the Order of the Pale Hour. It cuts so quickly that only the slash is ever seen.
flavor: The Order taught that a blade should be heard of, never seen.
name: Pale Hour Blade
